>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/reports/catalog"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the report catalog for the workspace's country, each entry annotated with `accountingDependent`. When `year` is supplied, each entry is also merged with its latest run (`status`, `taskId`, `runId`, `fileType`, `generatedAt`, `error` message) and a data-driven `available` boolean plus `unavailableReason` (`no_data_for_year` | `accounting_not_ready` | null). Pass `onlyAvailable=true` to return only generatable reports.

When `year` is supplied, entries also carry the plan-entitlement verdict for that year: `locked` (would `/generate` be refused), `lockCode` / `lockReason` / `lockData` (`{ current, limit }` on the count-based denials), and `grant` (`plan` | `free_allowance`) when unlocked. `available` and `locked` are independent — `available` is “is there anything to generate”, `locked` is “are you allowed to”. `onlyAvailable` filters on `available` only and never hides locked reports, so the paywall stays renderable.
